blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — ABS-CBN Corp. on Tuesday announced it will lay off about 200 employees, citing a “difficult year for the content industry” that led to weaker advertising and consumer spending. In a statement, ABS-CBN said it had made the difficult decision to implement the retrenchment program to keep the company “on strong financial footing.” This came despite new investments meant to help the entertainment giant rebuild and rebrand itself as a “global storytelling company.” READ: ABS-CBN lays off 100 more as ad revenues continue drop “However, it has been a difficult year for the content industry.
